instruction: A styled outdoor portrait with a medium shot captures a couple standing in front of a patterned grey marble wall. The bearded man in the brown cable-knit sweater (R1), wearing a dark fedora and round glasses, stands on the right looking left. The woman in the white knit sweater (R2), wearing a beige fedora, stands on the left looking in the same direction. The man wraps his arm over her shoulder, resting his hand on her chest, which she gently holds. The lighting is bright and even, emphasizing the warm brown and white tones against the cool marble background.
